# REM-125 — Expected tween-resolved coords (test-3 Source-B data-oracle)

**Owner:** dev-2 · **Fix commit:** `9708a2b` (branch `bugfix/REM-125-tween-variablesupport`) · **Generated:** data-driven from the corpus `.rc` via the fixed pipeline (doc-space, surface=-1/-1, density=1.0, static t=0).

## Why
REM-125: `DrawTweenPath` / `PathTween` were not `VariableSupport`, so a computed `tween`/`start`/`stop`
reached the geometry as raw NaN -> degenerate interpolation (e.g. `path_demo_path_tween_demo` rendered
BLANK despite draws=5 -> dispatch!=visual; the sweep status masked it). Fix resolves them via resolveCoord.

## How test-3 uses this (Source B, per-path)
For each tween doc below: assert the **resolved tween/start/stop** are finite (NOT NaN -- the bug left them
NaN) and the resulting interpolated path is **non-degenerate** (`distinct` ~= point count) and **spans** the
listed x/y range. `pts` are per-command endpoints in doc-space, 2-decimal rounded. Covers the 3 REM-121
overlap docs (clock_demo1, paths_demos, path_demo_path2) -- per-path scoped so REM-121 and REM-125 paths
are checked independently.

## Affected: 7 tween-op docs

RC-125-COORDS tween-docs=7
